title: Set up the division
text: Since tan(x) is odd, write it as $$a x+b x^3+c x^5$$ plus higher powers. Then $$\left(a x+b x^3+c x^5\right) \left(1-\frac{x^2}{2}+\frac{x^4}{24}\right)$$ must match $$x-\frac{x^3}{6}+\frac{x^5}{120}$$.

title: Match coefficients
text: Matching the coefficients of $$x$$, $$x^3$$ and $$x^5$$ gives $$a=1$$, $$b=\frac{1}{3}$$ and $$c=\frac{2}{15}$$.
